requirements.title: OUT_OF_RANGE argument restrictions and MOLD permission
requirements.definition: X shall be integer or real; MOLD shall be an integer or real scalar and need not be defined; ROUND shall be logical scalar and present only for real X with integer MOLD.

pending.OUT_OF_RANGE-X-integer-or-real: Positive source controls use integer and real X actuals; source-control mutation uses a logical or complex X and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.OUT_OF_RANGE-MOLD-integer-or-real-scalar: Positive controls use integer and real scalar MOLD actuals; source-control mutations use logical, complex, or array MOLD actuals and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.OUT_OF_RANGE-MOLD-value-not-required: Positive control passes an undefined scalar variable as MOLD and observes only its type and kind through the OUT_OF_RANGE result; mutation reads MOLD value so the control becomes invalid.
pending.OUT_OF_RANGE-ROUND-logical-scalar-real-t: Positive controls use ROUND=.true. and .false. only for real X with integer MOLD; source-control mutations use nonlogical ROUND or use ROUND with integer-to-integer and real-to-real cases and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: OUT_OF_RANGE integer MOLD without rounding uses truncation toward zero bound
requirements.definition: For integer MOLD with ROUND absent or false, the result is true exactly for IEEE infinity or NaN X, or for values whose largest-magnitude integer between zero and X inclusive is not representable by MOLD type and kind.

pending.OUT_OF_RANGE-integer-MOLD-truncation-fin: Guarded plan probes an integer kind pair with RANGE(large)>RANGE(small); with H=HUGE(0_small), assert OUT_OF_RANGE(H,0_small) is false and OUT_OF_RANGE(REAL(H,kind=exact_real)+0.25,0_small,ROUND=.false.) is false, relying on H as the portable representability boundary rather than its exact model value.

Using the guarded small/large integer-kind pair, assert OUT_OF_RANGE(INT(HUGE(0_small),large)+1_large,0_small) is true because the probed value is one greater than the MOLD-kind boundary; mutate the boundary relation back to H so the true case fails.

requirements.title: OUT_OF_RANGE integer MOLD with rounding uses NINT tie rule
requirements.definition: For integer MOLD with ROUND true, the result is true exactly for IEEE infinity or NaN X, or for values whose nearest integer, using the greater-magnitude tie rule, is not representable by MOLD type and kind.

pending.OUT_OF_RANGE-integer-MOLD-rounded-finite: Guarded plan first selects an integer kind k and real kind rk with RADIX(0_k)==2, RADIX(0.0_rk)==2, DIGITS(0.0_rk) >= DIGITS(0_k)+2, and sufficient RANGE to represent H=HUGE(0_k) exactly. RADIX(0_k)==2 makes H=2**q-1 for q=DIGITS(0_k); RADIX(0.0_rk)==2 makes the fractional-bit guard meaningful; the +0.25 case needs q+2 real significand bits. Assert OUT_OF_RANGE(REAL(H,rk)+0.25_rk,0_k,ROUND=.true.) is false after a .true. sentinel, testing the portable positive boundary relation.

Using the same guarded positive-boundary pair with RADIX(0_k)==2, RADIX(0.0_rk)==2, and DIGITS(0.0_rk) >= DIGITS(0_k)+2, assert OUT_OF_RANGE(REAL(HUGE(0_k),rk)+0.5_rk,0_k,ROUND=.true.) is true because the nearest integer by the greater-magnitude tie rule is H+1, not representable by kind k. The integer radix guard makes H=2**q-1, the real radix guard makes 0.5 exact in the same model, and this +0.5 case needs q+1 bits while the shared guard uses q+2 for the false companion. Mutate ROUND to .false. so the rounded case fails.

requirements.title: OUT_OF_RANGE real MOLD and remaining cases use representability in MOLD kind
requirements.definition: Otherwise, the result is true exactly for unsupported IEEE infinity or NaN values, or finite values whose rounded value in the extended model for MOLD kind exceeds the largest same-sign finite representable value of that type and kind.

pending.OUT_OF_RANGE-real-MOLD-finite-false: Same-kind model-relation plan asserts OUT_OF_RANGE(1.0_k,0.0_k) is false and OUT_OF_RANGE(HUGE(0.0_k),0.0_k) is false for each exercised real kind k, using HUGE only as that kind's own portable largest-finite boundary; mutate the first argument to a larger-kind overflow-boundary case so the false check fails.
pending.OUT_OF_RANGE-real-MOLD-finite-true: Guarded real-kind-pair plan selects RANGE(large)>RANGE(small), constructs a finite large-kind value whose EXPONENT exceeds EXPONENT(HUGE(0.0_small)), and asserts OUT_OF_RANGE(value,0.0_small) is true; mutate MOLD to the large kind so the true case fails. The exact decimal value is not asserted.

requirements.title: OUT_OF_RANGE IEEE infinity and NaN handling is guarded by IEEE support
requirements.definition: IEEE infinity and NaN values contribute true results for integer MOLD, and for real MOLD only those not supported by objects of MOLD type and kind contribute true results.

pending.OUT_OF_RANGE-IEEE-infinity-handling: Guarded plan queries IEEE_SUPPORT_INF for the source and MOLD kinds before constructing infinities with IEEE_VALUE; it asserts integer-MOLD true results and real-MOLD support relations without decimal-value comparisons or assumptions about unsupported IEEE values.
